notes: These are OPERATIONAL HEURISTICS for deciding when we have enough evidence to
look at an article's monetization by hand. They are NOT universal conversion
benchmarks and NOT claims about what converts.
Every gate is a named threshold in this file so it can be argued with and
revised once real audience data accumulates. There is no composite revenue score.
Defaults are deliberately conservative: staying silent beats manufacturing a
revenue conclusion from a sample that cannot support it.
